boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 61 fills a 6×8 grid with directional arrow blocks — green left-arrows on the left, red right-arrows on the right, blue left-arrows on top, green down-arrows on the bottom, and orange/red up-down blocks in the middle. Every block can only slide in its arrow direction. Clear the top and bottom rows first, then work the middle columns vertically.
landmarks: Block Out Level 61 fills a 6×8 grid with directional arrow blocks — green left-arrows on the left, red right-arrows on the right, blue left-arrows on top, green down-arrows on the bottom, and orange/red up-down blocks in the middle.
Every block can only slide in its arrow direction.
Clear the top and bottom rows first, then work the middle columns vertically.

quickTips: The arrows are constraints — a block with a left arrow can ONLY slide left. Plan around this.
Clear the top and bottom rows first to give the middle blocks room to slide vertically.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the top blue blocks with left arrows through the left exit.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the bottom green blocks with down arrows through the bottom exit.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Begin sliding the middle orange/red blocks vertically — up-arrow blocks go up, down-arrow blocks go down.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the left green blocks with left arrows through the left exit as the middle opens.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the right red blocks with right arrows through the right exit.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with any remaining middle blocks that need vertical sliding.

failurePoints: Trying to slide a block in a direction its arrow does not point — the arrow is a hard constraint, not a suggestion.
Clearing middle blocks before the top and bottom rows are open, which traps upper and lower blocks with no sliding room.
